target.title: feat(external): support macOS desktop credentials
target.body:
Replaces https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/976 after its stack base merged into main.

## Summary

- allow the generic `external` provider to preserve Linux, macOS, native Windows, and WSL2 targets, including ARM64 hosts
- persist target and Windows-mode routing so later lease commands restore the captured platform without overriding explicit target flags
- add source-bound external desktop credentials via username plus password environment-variable name
- use provider credentials consistently for WebVNC, screenshots, input, native VNC handoff, daemon children, and routed leases
- authenticate macOS ARD or legacy VNC locally, then expose an already-authenticated RFB stream without sending the desktop password to the coordinator
- add authenticated `webvnc --preflight`, including RFB 3.3, 3.7, 3.8, and accepted alias-banner handling
- validate native-Windows work roots against drive roots, user profiles, protected directories, traversal/ambiguous components, short names, ADS, and reserved device aliases
- document macOS credentials, native-Windows work-root requirements, preflight, and routing behavior

## Maintainer hardening

- merged current `main` and resolved the WebVNC/RFB stack against the one-time portal handoff architecture
- preserved legacy Parallels password-only VNC while using ARD accounts for provider-supplied macOS credentials
- kept registered static macOS endpoints host-managed and preserved two macOS WebVNC slots for controller plus observer
- made a configured-but-missing desktop password environment variable fail closed instead of falling back to an unrelated remote password file
- scrubbed desktop credentials from every unrelated provider, adapter, SSH, shell, and controller child while keeping the one credential-owning daemon on stdin only
- made persisted credential routes fail closed on malformed state, symlinks/reparse points, insecure ownership or permissions, and same-path replacement; generated children are bound to the exact route digest and cleanup to a unique generation
- preserved explicit, persisted, and server-labelled work roots even when they equal another platform's default
- made server-authenticated macOS portal viewers credential-free, with clean ACL-controlled share URLs and correct RFB 3.7 `None` negotiation
- made foreground SSH tunnel cleanup terminate and verify the full ProxyCommand process tree, including when the SSH leader already exited
- made canceled controller children wait for verified process-group exit before removing their durable recovery handle
- resolved registered macOS desktop credentials before scrubbing the daemon environment and forwarded them only through the one-shot supervisor stdin gate
- kept `webvnc status` usable without loading desktop secrets
- added a changelog entry thanking @MuduiClaw

## Verification

Exact head: `75b64da67dbfa9c276e52fbceebbdbfc4188e424`

- `go vet ./...`
- `go test -race ./...`
- `scripts/check-go-coverage.sh 90.0` — core coverage 90.3%
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — 54 command docs, 74 providers, 214 Markdown files, docs-site build
- `scripts/test-provider-lifecycles.sh`
- `scripts/test-go-modules.sh`
- `go run golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@v0.45.0 -test ./...`
- Linux, Windows, and Darwin `internal/cli` test-binary cross-compiles
- Worker format, lint, typecheck, 937 passed/3 skipped tests, and Wrangler dry-run builds
- branch-wide AutoReview after integrating current `main` found and fixed the registered auto-WebVNC credential handoff; the focused repair review and second full branch review both completed with no accepted/actionable findings
- exact-head externally orchestrated Crabbox Linux validation via `blacksmith-testbox` lease `tbx_01kx505602cdnhnea53qsxs6z7` — the remote command asserted `git rev-parse HEAD` equals `75b64da67dbfa9c276e52fbceebbdbfc4188e424`, completed with exit 0, stopped the one-shot lease, and confirmed no residual inventory ([delegated run](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29066317178); its Testbox step is expectedly canceled during Crabbox-owned teardown)
- exact-head hosted CI: 12/12 checks passed — [CI](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29066136355), [connector smokes](https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29066136339)
- credential-free process matrix at `b31436b21c189c08b0dba7561a0025294a9ca988` exercised Linux, macOS, native Windows, and WSL2 through the real CLI with local provider/SSH shims
  - persisted routing reused after config removal
  - hostile provider labels overwritten by trusted routing
  - POSIX, encoded PowerShell, and WSL2 command forms verified
  - macOS VNC output redacted; adapter environment isolated
  - all claims, routing, and synthetic provider resources removed

That process matrix remains supporting runtime proof. The current head integrates current `main`, adds the registered auto-WebVNC credential regression, and has fresh full Go race, Worker, script, docs, branch-review, hosted-CI, and exact-head Blacksmith Linux proof. Real External macOS Screen Sharing remains credential-bound: no approved test endpoint currently exposes both SSH and Screen Sharing with a task-scoped credential. No endpoint security settings were changed. Retain that provider-backed live-proof decision gate until such an endpoint is available or maintainers explicitly waive it.

## Security and configuration

The desktop password value is never stored in Crabbox config, routing state, argv, or portal handoff. Config and daemon routing carry only the environment-variable name. The Crabbox process reads the value when an authenticated desktop operation starts, preserves it as opaque data, and fails closed if the configured variable is absent or empty.

For macOS WebVNC, Crabbox authenticates to ARD/VNC locally and gives the browser/coordinator only an already-authenticated RFB stream. Repository config cannot redirect an inherited desktop credential reference without a matching trusted or explicit override.

target.title: feat: add GitHub Codespaces provider
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/348

## Summary

Adds a direct GitHub Codespaces Linux SSH-lease provider with aliases `codespaces` and `gh-codespaces`.

- Creates claim-owned GitHub Codespaces through the GitHub REST API and local `gh` authentication.
- Uses `gh codespace ssh --config` for Crabbox SSH, rsync, `run`, `ssh`, `status`, `stop`, and cleanup flows.
- Keeps the provider direct-only; it does not route through the Crabbox coordinator.
- Adds provider config/flags/env handling, generated metadata, docs, OpenSSH config parsing, lifecycle tests, and guarded live-smoke coverage.
- Persists durable pre-create recovery intent and binds lifecycle mutations to immutable Codespace, repository, owner, user, API-host, and account identity.
- Recovers ambiguous creates without adopting pre-existing resources; rejects duplicate claims; serializes slug allocation; and protects Touch, Resolve, Cleanup, and Release with locked compare-and-swap claim updates.
- Confirms asynchronous deletion by observing absence before removing recovery evidence.
- Keeps read-only resolution mutation-free and preserves dirty or uncertain resources for operator recovery.
- Selects host-specific authentication and SSH routing, rejects redirects, and stores generated SSH configuration with private cross-platform permissions.

## Verification

Exact candidate: `1e84bfb972afa53013167a5817908e1cf8d8a21c`

Local gates:

- `go test -race ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go build -trimpath -o bin/crabbox ./cmd/crabbox`
- `go run golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@v0.45.0 -test ./...` (no findings)
- Linux, macOS arm64, and Windows amd64 provider cross-compiles
- provider-matrix, command-doc, docs-link, and docs-site checks
- Worker format, lint, typecheck, build, and 934 tests
- GitHub Codespaces smoke contract: 6/6
- final full and scoped AutoReview passes: no accepted/actionable findings

Hosted exact-head gates:

- CI: 7/7 passed — https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29084189298
- Connector E2E: 5/5 passed — https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29084189280
- Blacksmith Testbox: provider `blacksmith-testbox`, lease `tbx_01kx5qe478gfwmjr4hp41f4952`, run https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/29084828852
  - asserted the exact candidate before and after the run
  - clean tree before and after the run
  - provider race suite
  - focused durable-claim and conditional-mutation race suite
  - provider/core vet
  - Windows amd64 cross-compile
  - exit 0; one-shot lease stopped and confirmed absent

GitHub reports this candidate MERGEABLE/CLEAN against the current base.

## Remaining live gate

Do not merge yet.

The implementation and exact-head hosted gates are ready for a maintainer decision, but a credentialed GitHub Codespaces lifecycle remains unproven. The currently authenticated `gh` token has `gist`, `read:org`, `repo`, and `workflow` scopes; `GET /user/codespaces` returns HTTP 403 and explicitly requires the additional `codespace` scope.

Before merge, authorize that persistent scope expansion and run a redacted exact-head create -> status -> synced run -> SSH -> clean delete proof, including observed final 404 and zero remote/local residue. Separately prove dirty/unpushed stop-and-retain behavior, then decide whether to accept the provider's billing and destructive-cleanup boundary.

target.title: feat(cua): add delegated-run provider
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/381

## Decision status

Do not merge yet. This candidate is blocked by the current upstream CUA create contract, not merely by a missing local retry implementation.

`cua-sandbox==0.1.17` exposes no create idempotency key, client-assigned name, or request metadata echoed by create/list/get. Its `Sandbox.create(name=...)` path treats a non-empty name as a connection to an existing VM, while the actual create request contains only OS, region, and resource settings. A timeout after a successful remote create can therefore leave a billed VM with no causally trustworthy identifier. Crabbox can retain a durable ambiguity record, but it cannot safely adopt or delete an inventory candidate.

Upstream must first provide and live-prove at least one ownership primitive:

- an idempotency key on create;
- a client-assigned unique name returned by create/list/get; or
- request metadata/nonce returned by create/list/get.

Without that primitive, the safe product choices are to defer this provider or narrow it to non-mutating doctor-only experimental support. Timestamp/config inventory matching is not safe under concurrent account activity.

Relevant pinned source:

- create transport: https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/sandbox-v0.1.17/libs/python/cua-sandbox/cua_sandbox/transport/cloud.py#L339-L380
- sandbox factory path: https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/sandbox-v0.1.17/libs/python/cua-sandbox/cua_sandbox/sandbox.py#L1045-L1078
- package contract: https://pypi.org/project/cua-sandbox/0.1.17/

## Candidate summary

- adds a CUA delegated-run provider with local configuration, provider metadata, registration, and documentation;
- implements warmup, fresh run, retained reuse, list/status/stop/cleanup, delegated archive sync, timing JSON, and operation locking;
- isolates the SDK bridge home, passes credentials through explicit environment only, strips provider auth from sandbox commands, and covers the embedded bridge with a subprocess contract test;
- attempts claim identity and cleanup checks, but cannot establish safe create ownership with the supported upstream API.

## Historical verification

Exact candidate: `113ce8e36c533a39c6a83ffad7b3211e1da0b1c5`

- `go vet ./...`
- `go run golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@v0.45.0 -test ./...`
- `scripts/check-go-coverage.sh 90.0`
- focused provider, registry, CLI, bridge, live-harness, docs, and generated-metadata tests
- prior branch AutoReview reported no actionable findings before the current ownership audit
- historical CI: https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/actions/runs/28693724088

This evidence is stale: the branch conflicts with current `main`, predates current Connector Lifecycles and Connector E2E lanes, and has no credentialed zero-residue CUA lifecycle proof.

## Work after the upstream gate

If CUA adds a trustworthy ownership primitive and the provider remains in product scope:

1. Merge current `main`, resolve the nine registry/config/docs conflicts, and regenerate provider metadata.
2. Pin and mutation-gate exactly `cua-sandbox==0.1.17` (or a later explicitly reviewed version), using Python `>=3.11,<3.14` and the `cua_sandbox` import only.
3. Persist durable create intent before mutation; bind claims to normalized endpoint plus stable authenticated workspace/account identity; retain every ambiguous outcome.
4. Require strong delete absence proof and compare-and-swap claim removal.
5. Keep destructive `forgetMissing` and the Python interpreter out of repository control; require an absolute trusted interpreter with isolated execution.
6. Replace full archive/base64/JSON buffering with bounded chunks or an explicit hard transfer limit.
7. Rerun the complete local gate, AutoReview, 7-job CI, 5-job Connector E2E, exact-head hosted Linux proof, and a credentialed create/run/reuse/stop/zero-residue lifecycle.

No usable CUA credential is currently available. Account creation/key issuance is a persistent-access action, and even a credential would not resolve the create-ownership blocker above.
